Vendored upstream Lua 5.5.1, released 24 July 2026.

Source: https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.5.1.tar.gz

SHA-256: `1c4b4068d67061f2a2231ad2b5422e77acea1487ea9890f6320af614f4373dce`

The original archive is retained without modifications. Builds verify its
checksum and extract a temporary copy, with no network access. Upstream
sources and documentation remain inside the archive; their size and layout
follow upstream conventions. Both `lua` and `luac` use this same archive.
